map.记录恒牙中龋坏（D）、因龋缺失（M）、因龋充填（F）的牙数，评估个体龋病经历。: Records the number of permanent teeth that are decayed (D), missing due to caries (M), and filled due to caries (F), to assess an individual's caries experience.
map.个体口腔检查后登记 D/M/F 牙数，工具汇总 DMFT 总分并定位高风险牙位。: After an individual oral exam, register the D/M/F tooth counts; the tool sums the DMFT total and identifies high-risk tooth positions.
map.群体口腔流调按年龄分层统计平均 DMFT，比较龋病流行水平。: Population oral surveys stratify by age to compute average DMFT and compare caries prevalence.
map.防龋干预一年后复查 DMFT 增量，评估措施效果。（结果仅供口腔健康科普与自我初: One year after caries-prevention intervention, recheck the DMFT increment to assess the measure's effect. (Results are for oral-health education and self-screening only, not a substitute for oral examination, periapical film/CBCT imaging, or diagnosis and treatment by dental, orthodontic or periodontal specialists; if you have toothache, gum bleeding, non-healing ulcers, abnormal oral mucosa or occlusal discomfort, please visit a regular hospital dental department promptly.)
map.输入：龋坏牙 D=3，因龋缺失 M=1，因龋充填 F=4\n计算：DMFT =:
Input: decayed D=3, missing due to caries M=1, filled due to caries F=4
Calculation: DMFT = D + M + F = 3 + 1 + 4 = 8
Note: a higher score means more caries experience; strengthen topical fluoride and diet management.
map.DMFT 和 dmft 区别？: What is the difference between DMFT and dmft?
map.DMFT 用于恒牙，dmft 用于乳牙（d 龋坏、m 因龋缺失、f 因龋充填）；: DMFT is for permanent teeth, dmft for primary teeth (d decayed, m missing due to caries, f filled due to caries); during the mixed dentition of children they must be recorded separately.
map.每颗牙按最严重状态计 1 次（D/M/F 取其一），同一牙不重复计分；已充填且有: Each tooth is counted once by its most severe status (one of D/M/F); the same tooth is not double-counted; a filled tooth with active caries is counted as D.
map.代表该口径下无龋坏、无因龋缺失、无因龋充填的牙，是防龋目标状态，但仍需定期口腔检: It means, under this definition, no decayed, no missing-due-to-caries and no filled-due-to-caries teeth; it is the caries-free target state, but regular dental check-ups are still needed.
